column3: MT 20:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “may it set you on high” is rendered “defend you.”
Close to the Hebrew; בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ (“your victory”) is rendered “your salvation.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “trust,” and “we make mention of the name” is rendered “we will remember the name.”
NKJV divides the line as “Save, LORD! May the King answer us,” where the Hebrew accents read “O LORD, save the king; may he answer us.”
